projects.title: Smart FM — Nokia HQ Dubai
projects.summary: Energy, air quality, and equipment monitoring for Nokia HQ Dubai—connected through IoTRICs and LoRaWAN.
projects.coverAlt: Contemporary corporate office building in Dubai
projects.solution:
The project connects energy sub-metering, air-quality monitoring, and predictive maintenance through IoTRICs, using LoRaWAN connectivity.

A practical workflow

  1. Review readings in the context of the monitored asset or space.
  2. Investigate exceptions and decide on the appropriate response.
  3. Record the response and continue reviewing the trend.
projects.seoTitle: Smart FM at Nokia HQ Dubai | Najhum
projects.seoDescription: Explore the Nokia HQ Dubai smart facilities project scope: IoTRICs energy sub-metering, indoor air-quality monitoring, predictive maintenance, and LoRaWAN.
projects.clientOverview: The Nokia HQ Dubai project brings energy sub-metering, indoor air-quality monitoring, and predictive maintenance into a connected facilities-management scope. IoTRICs and LoRaWAN link these monitoring areas to the everyday priorities of the facilities team.
projects.challenge: Managing corporate facilities means balancing energy use, occupant comfort, and equipment reliability. This project focuses on making those signals useful for day-to-day facilities decisions.
projects.results: The project focuses on more detailed energy visibility, indoor environmental awareness, and maintenance planning.
